text:
lucas_cs: Heads-up: BrightWave is doing a client-facing pilot from their SF office Friday 11:00 PDT. They asked for a short-term regional pin to us-west-1, an allowlist for their office range, and a temporary QPS increase to cover spike tests.

asha_onboard: Can you share the org id + IPs and the expected duration? We also need to know whether the demo will call non-standard routes (embed vs chat).

lucas_cs: Org: BRW-1142. IPs: 3.236.45.12, 3.236.45.13, and their office NAT 54.67.128.0/25. They'll run both chat and embeddings, but heavy chat traffic. Baseline 30 qps, target peak 250 qps for two separate 20-min windows within a 2-hour window. Request: 300 qps window for 2 hours to be safe.

todd_neteng: Ok. We prefer not to exceed 300 qps for short demos without SRE oncall, but 300 for 2h is fine if we pin routing to us-west-1 and add a header-based guard (x-brightwave-demo: 1). We'll create CHG-7720.

ops-bot: CHG-7720 created by todd_neteng. Window requested: 2026-05-01T18:00:00Z - 2026-05-01T20:10:00Z. Approvers: @ryan_support, @asha_onboard.

asha_onboard: Approving pending lucas confirmation that demo payloads are synthetic and no customer PII. Also request that lucas asks BrightWave to use the `staging-demo-key` if possible.

lucas_cs: Confirmed: synthetic data only. BrightWave agreed to use `staging-demo-key` for the session. Please proceed.

ops-bot: Change scheduled: pre-warm and apply rules at 2026-05-01T17:45:00Z. Ticket notes: include CIDR 54.67.128.0/25 and two /32s for 3.236.45.12, 3.236.45.13. Set qps_override=300, add header whitelist. Auto-revoke at 2026-05-01T20:00:00Z.

ryan_support: FYI, I'll collect post-demo metrics and check for any rate-limit anomalies or increased error rates. Planning a 10-minute smoke test at 17:55Z at 200 qps.

todd_neteng: Deploy started. I'll pin to us-west-1 edge and add the allowlist rule. Rule id: ALW-90014.

ops-bot: ALW-90014 applied at 2026-05-01T17:48:12Z.

ryan_support: Smoke test 17:55Z result: 10 min @200 qps, 95p latency 140ms, errors 0. Noted ephemeral spikes up to 240 qps during internal warm-up but handled.

lucas_cs: Demo passed. Customer asked if we can make a recurring weekly 2-hour staging pass for them. They liked using the `staging-demo-key`.

asha_onboard: We can propose a recurring scheduled window but need account exec signoff and billing adjustment for reserved demo bandwidth. I'll open a follow-up with CS Ops to propose an automated staging key with expiry and rate caps.

ops-bot: CHG-7720 closed at 2026-05-01T20:00:05Z (auto-revoke executed).

todd_neteng: Note for records: created reusable template: `demo_allowlist_template_v1` with required fields org_id, cidrs, ips, header_name, qps, duration_minutes, region_pin. Recommend using it for future quick turn requests.

lucas_cs: Thanks everyone. Ryan and Asha please send summary and renewal-risk note into the account doc. BrightWave mentioned they'd be open to an annual contract if we can guarantee demo bandwidth for sales presentations.

asha_onboard: Will do — capturing renewal interest. Closing thread after summary posted.
